limitations: incoming damage uses expected rolls, own damage uses minimum roll
NPCs are assumed to retain their observed target over the forecast horizon
a doomed windup is switched only when another viable target exists and the delayed command can arrive before release
miss reasons are diagnostics and can overlap causally
only the first episode per GPU slot is measured

misses.classification: exclusive proximate heuristics; samples include raw forecasts, no counterfactual causal claim

supplementary_inputs: visible units: current attack target and its generation, attack-ready time, windup release time
own hero: fractional windup rounding carry (reconstructible from past attacks)
tracking shots to observed targets: caster and target identity/generation, current position and speed; rolled shot damage is NOT read
static calibrated damage variance, type multipliers, hulls, turn and muzzle rules
